battle.name: 君子館之戰
battle.theater: 太原府榆次城北君子館
battle.brief: 太平興國十一年（986）十一月，宋太宗三路北伐的東路崩潰：曹彬自雄州退師，被耶律休哥追破於榆次城下；太原尹劉審所部屯於城北君子館，契丹大軍掩至，宋軍未成列即全線崩潰，劉審被擒。卡面羅馬短劍是刺突短兵的原型，並不在此戰場上，它代表的是短兵相接、以刺破甲的兵器譜系。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 北宋方面：宋太宗趙光義以中書門下與樞密院掌軍，太平興國十一年（986）九月下詔分三路北伐幽雲。東路由曹彬為行營都部署，率禁軍主力自雄州出師，通鑑記其眾二十萬；中路由田重統兵，攻飛狐口、崞縣、代州；西路由潘美為行營都部署、楊業副之，自麟州出邊。三軍之外，山西方面由太原尹劉審率晉陽守軍策應東路，糧秣則由河北、太原諸州轉輸，軍令出自京師，傳至前線要數旬。遼方則由幼主聖宗耶律景在位、攝政的蕭綽總攝軍政，與宋議和不成後傾力南來：耶律休哥領北面精騎追擊曹彬，耶律斜軫當西路，劉六符奉命入宋議和。契丹兵制以部族兵為骨幹，分北面官、南面官與宮分、蕃漢諸軍，騎兵自幼習射，步卒攜骨朵、短刀與硬弓，全軍戰法繫於騎兵迂迴分割。兩軍對峙的正是燕雲十六州這條既有邊界：宋志在收復幽燕，遼志在保住南天門與河北平原，君子館一役是這條邊界南端的生死之地。
countriesEn: The war was fought between the Northern Song and the Khitan Liao in 986, on the southern end of the frontier that separated the Central Plains from the Yan Yun Sixteen Prefectures. On the Song side, Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi (r. 976-997) directed the campaign through the Secretariat and the Bureau of Military Affairs, and in the ninth month of the Taiping Xingguo eleventh year he issued the order to attack Yan Yun in three separate columns. The eastern route, the largest of the three, was led by Cao Bin as chief commander of the field camp; he marched out of Youzhou with the imperial guard as his main strength, and the Zizhi Tongjian records his force as more than two hundred thousand men. The middle route was under Tian Zhong, who took Feihu Pass, Zhuo County and Dai Prefecture. The western route was commanded by Pan Mei as chief commander, with Yang Ye as his deputy, operating out of Linzhou. Alongside those three armies, Liu Shen, Inspector of Taiyuan, led the garrison of the provincial capital in Shanxi to support the eastern route, while grain and fodder were hauled forward out of the prefectures of Hebei and Taiyuan. Orders issued at the capital took weeks to reach the front, and command and supply were administered by separate offices. On the Liao side the boy emperor Shengzong Yelü Jing had not yet come of age, and real power lay with Xiao Chuo, the regent; after the peace mission to the Song failed, the Liao threw its strength southward. Yelü Xioge led the northern cavalry in pursuit of Cao Bin, Yelü Xiezhen held the western route, and Liu Liufu carried the failed embassy into the Song capital. Liao forces were built on tribal levies divided among the northern and southern administrations, the imperial guards and the mixed Han and foreign units. Their cavalry were trained with the bow from childhood, their foot carried gua-duo clubs, short sabres and stiff bows, and the whole army's way of fighting hung on cavalry manoeuvre and the splitting of an enemy formation. The two sides were facing each other along an old border: the Song wanted the Sixteen Prefectures back, the Liao wanted the Nan Tian Men line and the Hebei plain held, and Junziguan was the place where that frontier was to be decided.
people: 宋太宗趙光義是整場戰爭的決策者：他執意重啟北伐，把兵分三路、互不支援，最終又因東路崩潰而下詔令中、西兩路班師，戰後詔責曹彬、貶其官職，東征之望由此受挫。曹彬是東路統帥，先取河北容城一帶的岐溝關，旋因糧道不繼退師，被耶律休哥的追騎咬住而在榆次城下大潰；其退兵與議和之間的取捨，歷來有「朝廷遣使令其固守待和、曹彬誤讀詔意」與「自專退兵、坐逗留失利」兩種記載。劉審是君子館的實際主事者，以太原尹率晉陽兵赴援，屯營城北，軍潰時被亂兵推至前陣，陷於重圍被擒，其後下落史傳記載模糊。楊業是西路名將，與潘美部會師後遭耶律斜軫阻隔，孤軍陷於陳家谷口，力戰而歿，後追諡忠武王，其事成為後世說部中楊家將的母題。遼方以攝政的蕭綽為實際最高決策者，耶律休哥是追擊戰的實際統帥，劉六符則是議和使節，其出使被拒直接導致遼軍大舉南下。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi was the decision maker of the whole war: he insisted on reopening the northern campaign, divided the army into three columns that could not support one another, and when the eastern route collapsed issued the order for the middle and western routes to break off. After the defeat he censured Cao Bin and stripped him of office, and the prospect of a fresh northern expedition suffered accordingly. Cao Bin commanded the eastern route. He first took Jigou Pass in the neighbourhood of Rongcheng in Hebei, then withdrew because the supply line could not be sustained and was bitten by Yelü Xioge's pursuing cavalry until his army collapsed beneath the walls of Yuci. How he weighed his withdrawal against the peace negotiations remains disputed: one line of the record has the court sending an envoy to order him to hold fast pending a settlement, which he misread, another has him ordering a retreat on his own authority and being punished for delaying. Liu Shen was the man actually in charge at Junziguan. As Inspector of Taiyuan he led the Shanxi troops to the relief of the eastern route and encamped north of the city; when the line broke he was pushed forward by his own disorderly men, caught in the encirclement and taken prisoner, and what became of him afterwards is not clearly recorded. Yang Ye was the famous commander of the western route. After joining Pan Mei's force he was cut off by Yelü Xiezhen, was encircled with a handful of men at Chanjiagu, and died fighting; he was later posthumously granted the title of Martial Prince, and his fate became the seed from which the Yang family generals of later storytelling grew. On the Liao side the regent Xiao Chuo was the true high decision maker, Yelü Xioge was the field commander of the pursuit, and Liu Liufu was the envoy whose rejected terms set the Liao army moving south.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是羅馬短劍（gladius），約公元前100年已在羅馬軍團中列裝：雙刃直身，尖端收成刺突用的葉形，護手闊而重心貼前，揮砍不是它的本意，設計前提是單手持盾、以另一手刺擊。它與986年的君子館沒有任何接觸，現場沒有一件羅馬短劍；放在這張卡上，它代表的是「直刃刺突型短兵」這一兵器譜系的位置，也就是軍中最貼身、最講究節奏的那一層。真正決定榆次城下勝負的近身兵器是這些：宋軍步兵佩環首直刃刀，禁軍與近衛重裝備陌刀與短刀，弓弩手用神臂弓與步弩，長兵器有槊，護身有手牌與皮甲、札甲；遼軍契丹刀是窄身帶血槽的獵刀，步卒另備骨朵這類打擊棒，騎兵以硬弓、鵰弓與長刀、狼牙槍作戰。亂軍之中，貼身格鬥靠的正是短兵而非長兵：先以盾或甲身護住正面，再用刀劍的刺與短促的劈貼近完成殺傷；羅馬短劍所代表的刺突節奏，在宋軍環首刀、陌刀與遼軍骨朵、短刀上同樣看得到。糧秣與運輸方面，東路靠河北諸州的車馬與舟船接濟，曹彬攻岐溝關時曾遣人焚燒關下遼軍舟船；西線前後距離過遠，正是後來楊業部斷糧的根源。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman gladius, already in service in Roman legions by roughly 100 BC: a straight double-edged blade drawn to a leaf-shaped point for thrusting, with a broad guard and the weight carried close to the hand. Cutting was not its purpose. The design assumes a shield in one hand and a thrust with the other. It had no contact whatsoever with Junziguan in 986, and no gladius stood on that field. What the card represents is the place of the straight-bladed thrusting sword in the spectrum of weapons: the innermost, most rhythm-conscious layer of close combat. The weapons that actually decided the fighting beneath the walls of Yuci were these. Song infantry carried round-hilted straight sabres, guardsmen and close protection were armed with long two-handed dao and short blades, bow and crossbow men used the Shenli crossbow and the foot crossbow, longer weapons included the shuo, and body protection came from hand shields, leather armour and lamellar plates. The Liao side carried the Khitan sabre, a narrow hunting blade with a fuller, foot soldiers also bore gua-duo clubs, and the cavalry fought with stiff bows, powerful giauo bows, long sabres and barbed lances. In a broken formation, close combat rested on short weapons rather than long ones: the front was covered first with shield or armour, and the killing was finished with thrusts and short chops at close range. The thrusting rhythm that the gladius epitomises is just as visible in the Song round-hilted sabre and dao and in the Liao club and short knife. On supply and transport, the eastern route drew grain and fodder from the prefectures of Hebei by cart, horse and boat; Cao Bin had men burn the Liao shipping below Jigou Pass while taking the pass. The western route was stretched too far, and that distance is the root of the later hunger that closed in on Yang Ye's command.
tactics: 宋軍東路起初的步驟看似順利：曹彬先取河北容城一帶的岐溝關，關下遼軍舟船被焚，關內守軍腹背受敵而下，但軍糧接續不上，前線只得以倉促之師繼續推進，一旦退兵就立刻失去糧道。退兵成了整場戰爭最要命的環節：曹彬撤軍時隊伍飢疲混雜，耶律休哥不急於猛攻，只以精騎遠遠跟隨，等到宋軍抵達榆次城下、陣形鬆散、人馬疲憊之際，再集中精騎掩殺，宋軍當即崩潰，士卒奔入城內民家，契丹騎兵追入巷中屠殺，殺傷極慘。君子館之戰是崩盤的收尾：劉審所部與曹彬軍會合後屯於榆次城北，營壘未固、士氣已衰，契丹大軍掩至，諸軍不整、未能成列，劉審被亂兵推向前陣，軍隊隨即瓦解，兵甲、馬匹盡為敵所得。遼軍戰術的核心是追擊與誘敵：《遼史》記耶律休哥善用佯敗誘敵、近實遠虛之術，放開一線把宋軍引入預設的打擊位置再行合圍；同時以輕騎就草而食，不依賴長距離糧道，而宋軍每退一日，糧道即斷一日。
tacticsEn: The opening moves of the eastern route looked convincing. Cao Bin first took Jigou Pass in the Rongcheng area of Hebei, where the Liao shipping below the pass was burned and the defenders, caught between fire and assault, gave way; but the grain could not be sustained, the line could only press on with a hastily assembled army, and the moment it withdrew it lost its supply road. That withdrawal was the most fatal link in the whole campaign. As Cao Bin pulled back his columns were hungry, tired and mixed, and Yelü Xioge did not press the attack: he followed at a distance with picked cavalry, and waited until the Song army reached the walls of Yuci with its order broken and its men and horses exhausted before he concentrated the cavalry for the kill. The Song line collapsed at once, the soldiers fled into the houses inside the city, the Khitan horsemen rode in after them and killed in the streets, and the slaughter was fearful. Junziguan was the closing of the collapse. Liu Shen's troops had joined those of Cao Bin and encamped north of Yuci, their camp not yet entrenched and their morale already broken; the Khitan host came on them in force, the formations were never established, Liu Shen was shoved to the front by his own men, and the army came apart, losing its arms, horses and baggage to the enemy. The core of the Liao method was pursuit and deception. The Liao Shi records that Yelü Xioge was skilled at feigning defeat, drawing the enemy on, and striking where the blow would really fall, opening a gap to pull the Song into a prepared killing ground and then closing the trap. The Liao light horse ate off the grass and needed no long supply road, while every day the Song retreated, its supply road was cut one day further.
data: 可核對的數字有限，而且多經誇大。《資治通鑑》記曹彬東路出師之眾為二十萬，這反映的是傾國而出的態勢；契丹方面南征之眾多記為二十萬，實際集結與抵達戰線者當遠少於此，可靠的數字是耶律休哥追擊所領的精騎約五萬。時間線清楚：太平興國十一年九月出師，十一月榆次與君子館相繼崩潰，西路陳家谷之敗亦在同月，前後不過三個月。損失方面，榆次城下宋軍「死者數萬」，潰兵衝入民家而被追殺者不在此數之內；君子館宋軍全線崩潰，劉審被擒，部眾或死或降，器械馬匹盡失；西路楊業部數千將士全軍覆沒，楊業力戰歿於陳家谷。對宋廷的處置可查：曹彬坐逗留失利被貶，劉審以失律解職，楊業追諡忠武王。君子館距榆次城約十餘里，兩軍接觸在城北曠野，榆次城牆的守備與出城反擊都未及展開。雙方精確傷亡數至今無從核實，任何具體到個位數的說法都應視為附會。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, and most of them are inflated. The Zizhi Tongjian records Cao Bin's eastern column as more than two hundred thousand men, which reflects the all-out commitment of the state. The Liao host coming south is likewise given as two hundred thousand, though the number actually mustered and brought to the line of battle was far smaller; the reliable figure is the picked cavalry of about fifty thousand that Yelü Xioge led in the pursuit. The chronology is clear: the campaign opened in the ninth month of the Taiping Xingguo eleventh year, the collapse at Yuci and at Junziguan followed in the eleventh month, and the disaster at Chanjiagu on the western route came in the same month, so that the whole thing was over in about three months. On losses, the Song army beneath Yuci is recorded as having tens of thousands dead, not counting those killed in the houses the routed men fled into; at Junziguan the Song line disintegrated completely, Liu Shen was taken prisoner, his men were killed or surrendered, and arms and horses were lost; on the western route Yang Ye's command, several thousand men, was wiped out and Yang Ye died fighting at Chanjiagu. The court's response is on record: Cao Bin was demoted for hanging back, Liu Shen was relieved of his command for the disorder of his troops, and Yang Ye was posthumously honoured as Martial Prince. Junziguan lay a little over ten li north of the city of Yuci; the two armies met in open ground north of the walls, and neither the garrison's defence of the walls nor any sortie from the city got the chance to develop. The exact casualty figures on both sides cannot be established, and any claim specific down to the individual should be treated as later embroidery.
cause: 宋太宗北伐的直接起因是收回幽雲十六州——這片土地自後晉石敬瑭割讓以來一直是中原王朝的目標。979年高梁河之敗後，太宗並未放棄，只是收斂了旗鼓；986年，遼主耶律景年幼、攝政的蕭綽內部尚未完全穩定，宋廷以為有機可乘，遂下詔分路北伐。但真正點火的是外交：遼使劉六符入宋議和，所提條件包括宋主稱弟、歲輸幣帛、劃界等，太宗一概不許；劉六符回報之後，遼軍反而先取攻勢，使宋廷在軍事尚未就緒時被迫應戰，情報上的劣勢由此形成。接著是節奏失控：中路田重攻飛狐口、崞縣、代州節節得手，刺激前線求戰；東路曹彬因糧道不繼請退，詔令與議和的時序互相牽制，進退失據，最終演成被追兵黏住潰散。制度上，宋代邊軍由禁軍、廂軍、鄉兵混編，調集與補給分屬不同衙署，一旦深入數百里的邊境，命令與糧秣的傳遞速度都跟不上戰爭本身。
causeEn: The direct cause of the northern campaign was the recovery of the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan Yun, territory that had been ceded by Shi Jingtang of Later Jin and had remained the standing objective of the Central Plain dynasties ever since. After the defeat at Gaoliang River in 979, Taizong had not given the idea up; he had only folded his banners. In 986, with the Liao emperor Yelü Jing a boy and the regency of Xiao Chuo not yet fully settled, the Song court judged that an opportunity existed, and the order went out for a three-column advance. What actually lit the fuse, however, was diplomacy. The Liao envoy Liu Liufu came to the Song to negotiate, and his terms included the Song ruler's adoption of a junior fraternal title, annual payment of silk and coin, and a demarcation of the border; Taizong refused all of it. When Liu Liufu carried the refusal back, the Liao took the offensive first, and the Song was forced to fight before its preparations were complete, which is where the disadvantage in information began. Then the tempo got out of hand. The middle route under Tian Zhong took Feihu Pass, Zhuo County and Dai Prefecture in succession, which goaded the forward columns into pressing ahead; and on the eastern route Cao Bin, his supply line failing, asked to withdraw, while the timing of the imperial orders and of the peace talks held each other in check, so that advance and retreat were both out of step and the army ended up stuck to a pursuing enemy and scattered. Underneath it all was institutional: Song frontier forces were mixed draws of imperial guards, provincial troops and local militia, mustering and supply were run by different offices, and once an army went several hundred li into the frontier, neither orders nor grain could travel as fast as the war.
impact: 這場敗仗是北宋前期一次關鍵性的挫敗。東、中、西三路同時崩潰，士卒折損慘重，器械、馬匹、輜重盡失，太宗自979年以來第二次北伐的成果全部落空；尤其在史家筆下，曹彬以二十萬眾出師而一朝潰散被視為用兵上的敗筆，連帶影響到往後對北方統帥人選的信任。此後宋廷的國策明顯由攻轉守：河北、山東沿線塘泊、城寨的經營被加強，禁軍冗兵逐步裁汰，邊防重心由「取幽燕」改為「固守正南」，這條保守路線一路延續到景德元年澶淵之盟以歲幣換和平，其間宋廷付出的財政代價遠高於一次北伐的消耗。對契丹而言，君子館的勝利鞏固了燕雲防線，讓遼得以抽出手腳處理西邊高麗與西北部族的事務，也確立了遼軍在野戰中追擊宋軍殘部的典型戰例：在對手斷糧而己方可以就地取給的條件下，靜待其潰再行收割，比正面強攻更省力。文化層面上，楊業歿於陳家谷、劉審陷於君子館，成為後世說部與戲曲中最常用的悲劇母題，楊家將的忠烈形象正是在這一串真實敗績上疊加想像而成。
impactEn: This defeat was a decisive reverse for the early Northern Song. All three columns collapsed at once, the troops were cut up badly, arms, horses and baggage were lost, and everything Taizong had sought in his second northern campaign since 979 was thrown away. In the historians' view Cao Bin's ruin after taking the field with two hundred thousand men became a byword for bad generalship, and it coloured the court's later thinking about who might be trusted to command in the north. The state policy then turned visibly from attack to defence: the pond-and-fort system along the Hebei and Shandong lines was reinforced, redundant troops in the imperial guards were cut back, and the frontier emphasis shifted from taking Yan Yun to holding the line to the south. That cautious line ran all the way to the Chanyuan Treaty of 1004, where peace was bought with annual payments, and the fiscal cost of it to the Song treasury was far greater than the cost of one northern campaign. For the Khitans the victory at Junziguan consolidated the Yan Yun defence line and freed hands for the western front against Goryeo and the north-western tribes, and it established a set-piece precedent for Liao pursuit of broken Song columns in the field: when the enemy has run out of grain and your own horse can graze, it is cheaper to wait for the rout and harvest it than to assault frontally. On the cultural level, Yang Ye's death at Chanjiagu and Liu Shen's capture at Junziguan became the most-used tragic motifs of later storytelling and opera; the loyal image of the Yang family generals was built by piling invention on top of this string of real defeats.
result: 君子館一役的直接結果是宋軍東路全盤覆沒：劉審被俘，部將或死或降，兵甲馬匹為遼軍所獲，榆次以北至太原一線的宋軍兵勢為之一空。消息傳回京師，宋太宗詔令中路田重部與西路潘美、楊業部班師；中路自代州退還，途中雖仍有小勝，戰果未能帶回；西路最慘，潘美部與楊業部被耶律斜軫隔斷，楊業率孤軍北向求援不得，陷於陳家谷口，全軍覆沒，楊業力戰被殺。遼軍雖取大勝，休哥追至太原城下，見宋軍退入城中、太原守備尚固，也未敢深入，遂撤軍北去。三路北伐至此全面失敗，宋太宗下詔切責諸將，斬殺、貶黜多人，國庫為此次戰事與善後付出了一大筆開支。此後近二十年，宋遼在邊境上維持對峙：宋不再主動大舉深入，遼亦未再傾國南下，直到1004年澶淵之盟重新劃定疆界與歲幣之制，才把兩國的關係拉回穩態。君子館則以宋軍最慘的一次野戰崩潰，留在北宋前期邊防史上最刺眼的一頁。
resultEn: The immediate result of Junziguan was the total loss of the Song eastern route. Liu Shen was taken prisoner, his commanders were killed or surrendered, arms and horses fell to the Liao, and the Song military presence from Yuci north to Taiyuan was wiped out. When the news reached the capital, Taizong ordered the middle column under Tian Zhong and the western column under Pan Mei and Yang Ye to break off. The middle route withdrew from Dai Prefecture, still winning small engagements on the way but unable to bring back the results. The western route fared worst: Pan Mei's force and Yang Ye's were cut apart by Yelü Xiezhen, and Yang Ye, leading a few men north in the hope of help, was trapped at Chanjiagu with his entire command destroyed, dying in the fight. The Liao won heavily, but Xioge did not press on to the foot of Taiyuan: seeing the Song troops drawn back inside the walls and the city still defensible, he withdrew north. The three-column campaign failed outright. Taizong issued a general censure, executed and demoted a number of officers, and the treasury paid a large bill for the campaign and its aftermath. For the better part of the following two decades Song and Liao held a standoff on the border: the Song no longer launched great offensives into the north, and the Liao did not put the whole realm into the field again, until the Chanyuan Treaty of 1004 redrew the border and fixed the annual payments and put the relationship between the two states back on an even footing. Junziguan remains, in the frontier history of the early Northern Song, the most glaring page of open-field collapse in a Song army's history.
